bio: Michele Moraca was baptized on 2 June 1748 at San Mango D'Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy, the son of Luca Moraca and Lucrezia Frajacouo. Two of his children, Alessio, born in 1772, and Agata, born in 1777, are both ancestors of John, so Michele is John's 5th-great-grandfather by two lines.
